study: Grid resolution, current robust selection version 2
order: Evaluate exact fine baseline then progressively coarser joint grids, axis sweeps, phase shifts, incumbent.
endpoints: Preserved at every spacing. Terminal joint grid has 2 RSI values x 2 targets.
outer_test: Annual flat-start frozen policy with expanding training; 2026 ends at cutoff. Not a daily reoptimization replay.
cohort: Current cached products; eligibility separately requires prior 630 aligned sessions and 126 test sessions.
activity: Selector v2 unchanged; outer annual completed trade rate and activity utility reported separately.
outliers: Reject unsupported parameter peaks using v2 development gates and neighbor cap. Keep every valid outcome in primary analysis; symmetric 10% proxy trimming and leave-one-proxy-out sensitivity only.
decision: Only identify an optimum with supported noninferiority and a supported degradation boundary; otherwise report unresolved, exhaust the registered ladder, retain incumbent defaults.
frozen_confirmation: Freeze an evidence-qualified candidate if any; otherwise smallest-grid exploratory leader by validation utility, plus baseline/incumbent and adjacent joint grids. Never promote exploratory ranking without evidence gates.
runtime: Separate warmed uncached select_strategy timing, 5 deterministic representative assets, 3 repeats per grid, randomized order; no union cache timings used for speedup.
prior_inspection: Historical data previously researched; retrospective confirmation, not pristine holdout. TQQQ pre-2022 prefix used only in a runtime pilot before registration.
